embeddedCrossCheck.scriptSource:
import hashlib, json, pathlib, re

def r1_cross_check(contract_path, evidence_path):
    sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    md = pathlib.Path(contract_path).read_text(encoding="utf8")
    e = json.loads(pathlib.Path(evidence_path).read_text(encoding="utf8"))
    ids = lambda pat: sorted(set(re.findall(pat, md)))
    declared = {
        "requirements": ids(r"R1-REQ-\d\d"), "refusals": ids(r"R1-RF-\d\d"), "states": ids(r"R1-ST-\d\d"),
        "outOfScope": ids(r"R1-OOS-\d\d"), "transitions": ids(r"R1-TR-\d\d"),
    }
    ledger = e["ledger"]
    ledgerMatches = all(declared[k] == sorted(ledger[k]) for k in declared)
    cases = e["casePlan"]["cases"]
    caseIds = [c["caseId"] for c in cases]
    needed = set(x for v in declared.values() for x in v)
    covered = set(x for c in cases for x in c["covers"])
    uncovered = sorted(needed - covered)
    unknownCovers = sorted(covered - needed)
    allUnexecuted = all(c["status"] == "NOT_EXECUTED_PLANNED" for c in cases)
    uniqueCases = len(caseIds) == len(set(caseIds))
    # seal recompute
    s = e["r1Seal"]
    raw = s["canonicalPayload"].encode("utf-8")
    obj = json.loads(s["canonicalPayload"])
    recanon = json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True).encode("utf-8")
    sealDigestOk = sha(raw) == s["digestSha256"] and recanon == raw and not raw.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf") and not raw.endswith(b"\n")
    drift = sorted(p for p, h in obj["sourceSha256"].items() if sha(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()) != h)
    # locators
    bad = []
    for l in e["locators"]:
        lines = pathlib.Path(l["file"]).read_text(encoding="utf8").split("\n")
        if not (l["line"] <= len(lines) and l["expectedSubstring"] in lines[l["line"] - 1]):
            bad.append(l["id"])
    # original-to-R1 mapping completeness
    inv = e["originalInventory"]
    m = e["originalToR1Map"]
    mappedIds = set(x["original"] for x in m["ids"])
    mappedCases = set(x["original"] for x in m["cases"])
    origIds = set(x for k in ("requirements", "refusals", "states", "outOfScope", "transitions") for x in inv[k])
    missingIdMap = sorted(origIds - mappedIds)
    missingCaseMap = sorted(set(inv["cases"]) - mappedCases)
    r1CaseRefs = set(c for x in m["cases"] for c in x["r1Cases"])
    danglingMap = sorted(r1CaseRefs - set(caseIds))
    disp_ok = all(x["disposition"] in ("retained", "revised", "superseded") and x["reason"] for x in m["cases"] + m["ids"])
    ok = (ledgerMatches and not uncovered and not unknownCovers and allUnexecuted and uniqueCases and sealDigestOk
          and not drift and not bad and not missingIdMap and not missingCaseMap and not danglingMap and disp_ok)
    return {
        "result": "PASS_STATIC_ONLY" if ok else "FAIL",
        "declaredCounts": {k: len(v) for k, v in declared.items()},
        "ledgerMatchesDocument": ledgerMatches,
        "caseCount": len(cases), "uniqueCaseIds": uniqueCases,
        "uncoveredIds": uncovered, "casesCoverUnknownIds": unknownCovers,
        "allCasesNotExecutedPlanned": allUnexecuted,
        "sealDigestRecomputed": sealDigestOk,
        "sourceHashDriftSinceSeal": drift,
        "locatorsTotal": len(e["locators"]), "locatorsUnresolved": bad,
        "originalIdsUnmapped": missingIdMap, "originalCasesUnmapped": missingCaseMap,
        "mapReferencesMissingR1Case": danglingMap,
        "mapDispositionsComplete": disp_ok,
    }
